title: Outstandingly Juicy Canadian Beef Burger
description: A show-off Canadian dish featuring dried oregano and a buttery flavor, this burger is both juicy and flavorful, making it a great option for a dinner meal that is buddhist-temple-friendly as it does not contain any forbidden ingredients for buddhist dietary preferences.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, around 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, mixing with your hands or a spoon until just combined.
Divide the beef mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a ball, then flatten each ball into a patty about 3/4 inch thick.

Add the butter to the preheated grill or grill pan and let it melt, then add the patties and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 130 degrees Fahrenheit for medium-rare.
While the burgers are cooking, toast the buns on the grill or in a toaster.
Assemble the burgers by spreading a slice of cheese on the bottom bun, if using, then adding a cooked patty, a few slices of onion, and finally the top bun.
Let the burgers rest for a few minutes before serving.
